description: A schema for a Total CMS Video object: one hosted video (YouTube, Vimeo, Livid, Bunny, Cloudflare Stream, Loom, Wistia or a direct file URL) with an optional poster

id.label: Video ID
id.help: A unique ID for this video. No spaces or special characters.

video.label: Video
video.help: Paste the video's URL. The provider, thumbnail and title are detected when you save; upload a poster to override the thumbnail.
